Several AI model releases were announced in early-to-mid October 2026, according to two tracker sites. I didn't find official announcements from the labs, so treat these dates as secondhand.

- **Meta, Muse Spark Open (Oct 15):** The most recent release on one tracker. It is Meta's new open-weight model for coding and agent tasks, which Meta calls the most capable US open-weight model so far. Its weights are free to download, while Meta's top Muse Wonder models stay closed.
- **Google, Gemini 4 Argon (Oct 13):** Its general availability release. Google's model had first launched only to vetted cyber defenders, and it is now available through the paid Gemini API, AI Studio, and Google Cloud.
- **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (Oct 17):** The newest entry on another aggregator, which lists 14 October releases. It is listed as released by DeepSeek on October 17, 2026.
- **xAI, Grok Voice 3.0 (Oct 14):** Listed as released October 14, 2026.
- **OpenAI, GPT-6 (Oct 6–7):** One tracker lists GPT-6 & Intelligent UI in ChatGPT (All Users) (Oct 7, 2026), while the other lists a model called GPT-6 Luna Decisions released October 6. The sources disagree on the date and the model names, so check OpenAI's own announcements.
- **Anthropic, Claude Haiku 5.5 (Oct 7):** Listed as the latest Anthropic release on the same tracker.

Other October entries from the aggregator include Meta's Muse Wonder 1.0 (Oct 12), Reka Edge 2603 (Oct 9), Alibaba's Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo (Oct 9), and Z.AI's GLM 5.3 Fast (Oct 7).

Several new models launched between October 13 and 18, 2026. Meta's open-weight release and DeepSeek's update are the most prominent. Dates vary somewhat across trackers, and I couldn't confirm most of these on primary company pages.

**Most recent (October 15-17)**
- **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (DeepSeek, Oct 17):** The newest is DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 from DeepSeek, released October 17, 2026. One tracker describes it as an in-place upgrade with stronger agent scores. This is the only source I found for the Oct 17 date, so treat it as less certain.
- **Muse Spark Open (Meta, Oct 15):** Meta calls it "the most capable US open-weight model to date". It has 816 billion parameters and a 1 million token context window, and is natively multimodal and built for complex coding tasks and agentic labor. Meta says it runs on two Mac Studios with M5 Ultra chips.
- **FLUX 3 Image Klein (Black Forest Labs, Oct 15):** a 5.6B open-weights model from Black Forest Labs for text-to-image, editing and up to 10 reference images.
- **Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B and Nemotron 3.5 Super VL (NVIDIA, Oct 15):** Listed as released on 15 Oct by one tracker, which noted that NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super VL added another open-weight option for agents working across documents, images and video.

**October 13-14**
- **Grok Voice 3.0 (xAI, Oct 14):** the new speech-to-speech model in xAI's Voice Agent API.
- **Jev 1.14 (TypeSafe AI, Oct 14):** TypeSafe AI's new decision model, out now as jev-preview.
- **Gemini 4 Argon (Google, Oct 13):** One tracker lists this as the latest Google release, with Google's newest frontier model now broadly available, after launching only to vetted cyber defenders.
- **Fish Audio Drama 3 (Fish Audio, Oct 13):** an open-weight 35B MoE text-to-speech model (3B active) that voices up to 16 characters
- **Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full (Meta, Oct 12 or 13):** Meta's frontier agent models. Trackers differ on the date: one lists Oct 12, while a weekly roundup places it on Tuesday, Oct 13. The Muse Wonder models stay closed.

**Other items**
- Ring-1T (InclusionAI, Oct 13) appears in one tracker, but I found no details on it.

Sources are aggregator trackers and secondary news rather than official announcements, so check the providers' own sites for exact dates and availability.

content.content:
Web search results for query: "Gemini 4 Argon generally available Gemini API"

Links: [{"title":"Google expands Gemini 4 Argon access across API and subscriber products","url":"https://letsdatascience.com/news/google-releases-gemini-4-argon-for-scientific-computing-644a49ff"},{"title":"Gemini 4 Argon is available today, where to use it and what it costs","url":"https://pasqualepillitteri.it/en/news/23457/gemini-4-argon-disponibile-dove-usarlo-prezzo-en"},{"title":"Gemini 4 Argon llega, dónde usarlo y cuánto cuesta","url":"https://pasqualepillitteri.it/es/news/23459/gemini-4-argon-disponibile-dove-usarlo-prezzo-es"},{"title":"Gemini 4 Argon chega ao app Gemini, onde usar e qual o preço","url":"https://pasqualepillitteri.it/pt/news/23478/gemini-4-argon-disponibile-dove-usarlo-prezzo-pt"},{"title":"Gemini 4 Argon now available: long decode, limits, pricing","url":"https://braindetox.kr/en/posts/gemini_4_argon_general_availability_2026.html"},{"title":"Gemini 4 Argon: API price, access, and context","url":"https://toolhalla.ai/blog/gemini-4-argon-api-price-context-2026"},{"title":"gemini 4 argon public independent tests rank it first and eighth","url":"https://letsdatascience.com/blog/gemini-4-argon-public-independent-tests-rank-it-first-and-eighth"},{"title":"Українська правда","url":"https://mezha.ua/en/news/google-gemini-4-argon-316145/"},{"title":"Українська правда","url":"https://mezha.ua/en/news/google-gemini-4-argon-316145/amp/"}]

Yes. Google made Gemini 4 Argon broadly available on October 13, 2026, and the Gemini API changelog labels it general availability (GA) under the model ID `gemini-4-argon`. The changelog entry for 13 Oct 2026 says: "Gemini 4 Argon (gemini-4-argon) generally available (GA)."

**Access**
- **Gemini API:** Developers on the paid tier can call it. Google said on Oct. 13 that Gemini 4 Argon is now available to developers and enterprises through the Gemini API, AI Studio and the Gemini platform.
- **Subscriber products:** Access is expanding to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Antigravity and to Google AI Ultra and Pro subscribers in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search.
- **Rollout:** One report says Google describes a gradual, global rollout, so the model may show up in your account's model picker a few hours late.

**Pricing and limits**
- The introductory API price is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens. From November 30, 2026 it rises to 4 and 20.
- The documentation lists a combined input-output context limit of 1,048,576 tokens, plus support for tools including code execution, function calling, file search and URL context.

**Background**
Argon was not new on October 13. The company had first unveiled Argon to a limited group of cybersecurity partners on September 30.

**Caveats**
- Google's documentation mostly avoids the exact phrase "generally available." One analysis notes that for the model itself it uses "now available" and "Stable." The meaning is the same, since the identifier has no preview suffix.
- Coverage is not uniform across Google's products. One Spanish-language report says the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform release notes do not yet include an entry for Argon, while the Gemini API changelog lists it with general availability and the identifier gemini-4-argon.

Web search results for query: "Meta Muse Wonder launch"

Links: [{"title":"Muse Wonder puts Meta back in the AI race with frontier models","url":"https://yourstory.com/ai-story/muse-wonder-meta-ai-race-frontier-models"},{"title":"2610 meta launches muse wonder series to rival anthropic openai models","url":"https://www.businessinsider.jp/article/2610-meta-launches-muse-wonder-series-to-rival-anthropic-openai-models/"},{"title":"Meta Enters AI Frontier With New “Wonder” Models","url":"https://propakistani.pk/2026/10/13/meta-enters-ai-frontier-with-new-wonder-models/"},{"title":"Meta Launches Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full for Agentic Tasks","url":"https://letsdatascience.com/news/meta-launches-muse-wonder-and-muse-wonder-full-for-agentic-t-41113cca"},{"title":"Meta Enters AI Frontier With New “Wonder” Models","url":"https://propakistani.pk/2026/10/13/meta-enters-ai-frontier-with-new-wonder-models/amp/"},{"title":"Meta Muse Wonder: what it is, what it costs, and which version you get","url":"https://www.eesel.ai/blog/meta-muse-wonder"},{"title":"ainews meta muse wonder and wonder","url":"https://latent.space/p/ainews-meta-muse-wonder-and-wonder"},{"title":"Itdaily - Meta toeing the line for Trump with Muse Wonder launch: yet another American frontier LLM","url":"https://itdaily.com/blogs/innovation/meta-muse-wonder-full/"},{"title":"Українська правда","url":"https://mezha.ua/en/news/meta-muse-wonder-316096/"}]

Meta launched Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full on October 12, 2026, as its most capable models so far.

- **Launch and positioning:** Released by its Superintelligence Lab on October 12, 2026, the models are designed to handle demanding personal and professional tasks. Meta's own team says Wonder is "a much larger and more advanced class of models that brings us to the frontier." The line is intended to follow Muse Spark, which is lighter and faster.
- **Access:** Muse Wonder is available through Meta's Model API and Muse Code. Wonder Full is limited to Muse Code subscribers. Muse Wonder Full is only in the Muse Code Power ($50/month) and Max ($200/month) plans. Pricing for the API version has been reported as four dollars per million input tokens and twenty dollars per million output tokens.
- **Capabilities:** Meta highlights two features. Active Memory carries relevant information across conversations, while Active Focus is meant to help a model continue a multi-step task, recover from errors, and request clarification before consequential actions. The models also take text, images, video, audio and PDFs as input, with a 1,048,576-token context window.
- **Muse app:** Wonder is not yet in the consumer app. Meta says Wonder will soon power experiences in its Muse product, beginning with subscribers, but did not provide a broader rollout schedule.
- **Benchmarks:** These are contested. Independent Artificial Analysis scores put Claude Opus 5.5 at 58, Muse Wonder Full at 56, and the API-facing Muse Wonder at 52. Meta's own figures are described as Meta claims, rather than independently established results.
- **Early uptake:** Estimates from app intelligence firm Apptopia put Muse at about 1.8 million iOS downloads in the US and Canada in its first 12 days, compared with 1.3 million for ChatGPT over the same period after its mobile launch. These are third-party estimates, not official figures from either company.

Note that the sources differ on some details, such as the exact subscription tiers and whether the API version is still a preview. Meta has also not disclosed the parameter count for the models.
